title: ExceptionalFiniteSupportRealization
statement: For a compactification and the actual strict etale compact-support construction [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], define the fixed-coefficient realization of its open extension by the full Hom-transpose equation relative to the inverse comparison [def-pur-adic-etale-realization]. Derive this exact comparison with its square on every cochain representative. Compose it with the universal-unit-normalized proper direct-image comparison to obtain the compact-support comparison at that same compactification. Its right-adjoint comparison is uniquely specified by the Hom-transpose equation for every pair of objects and every compact-support morphism.

proof.text: For two adjunctions and a square, expand both Hom transposes using their units. Naturality of the right square and its mate unit equation give the full Hom-transpose equation for every arrow. Apply this to the inverse mate of integralExceptionalEtaleInverse. Both realization functors are equivalences, so the existing inverse-mate invertibility theorem supplies the open-extension isomorphism. If another isomorphism satisfies the equation, evaluate at the identity of each left-adjoint image and use injectivity of the target Hom equivalence to identify the inverse components.

Apply NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex to the ordinary open comparison. Form two comparison isomorphisms from Q followed by the two derived composites to the same functor on complexes: one uses the source realization factorization followed by the ordinary open-extension factorization, and the other uses levelOpenFactors, the target realization factorization, and the complex comparison. The composite of the latter with the inverse of the former descends uniquely through Q, because precomposition with a localization is fully faithful (Localization.fullyFaithfulWhiskeringLeft). Its normalization square is the equality (b followed by a inverse) followed by a equals b. For uniqueness, cancel the invertible normalization factors at each Q(J), then use Localization.natTrans_ext.

Keep the compact-support comparison as its existing composite of the exact open comparison and the normalized proper comparison. Apply the existing forward-mate invertibility theorem to its inverse, the generic finite exceptional adjunction, and the fixed compact-support adjunction; the derived realizations are equivalences. The mate unit equation and naturality give exactly IsIntegralExceptionalEtaleRightAdjoint. For uniqueness, evaluate that Hom-transpose equation on each counit of the generic adjunction. Its transpose is the identity by the triangle identity, so the right-comparison components agree.

proof_origin.place: The three existing declaration docstring proofs, implemented using the library mate-invertibility lemmas and Mathlib localization full faithfulness. No change to the purity-transport unit route.
